\section{Method}
For every sample $x \in \R^d$ we minimise
\begin{equation}
  \loss(\theta) = \E_{x}\, \norm{f_\theta(x) - x}^2 \label{eq:loss}
\end{equation}
over $\theta$.

\section{Bounds}
\begin{align}
  a &\leq b \label{eq:first} \\
  b &\leq c \notag
\end{align}
